settings.title: A cold storage facility built to grow.

settings.editor: Glacier West has worked on the Surrey cold storage facility through multiple phases.
The 132,000 SF facility includes freezer, cooler, and loading dock space.
A track record of large, multi-phase facilities.
The building envelope plays a critical role in the performance of any cold storage facility.
Whether you’re developing a cold storage facility, food processing plant, or industrial facility, Glacier West has the expertise to help bring your project from concept to completion.
